ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
没事没事，是我没注意。
你没受伤吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 你的音乐，能让我幸福

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
呵呵，我猜对了呢♪
毕竟你一脸新奇地东张西望来着

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今后也要拜托你了♪

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
那就好。要是伤到像你
这么可爱的女孩子，那可不得了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 茉幌同学，该起床了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
如果不要点心，
那去车库来场即兴合奏怎么样？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 没有……又是不读不回

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……哎呀？这不是刚才的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 那就更说明，萤同学你该唱了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是呀，听得人心醉的歌声哦♡

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……这么一想，就让人兴奋得发抖呢♪

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
在昏暗狭小的空间里，
密密麻麻地挤满了一大群人

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 僵尸片♪

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……没问题哦

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_027
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 防晒霜的话，喷雾型的既方便又好用呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Name: voice_028
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.Text: 炎热的夏天，总是让人忍不住想吃辣的东西

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
没事没事，是我没注意。
你没受伤吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 你的音乐，能让我幸福

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
呵呵，我猜对了呢♪
毕竟你一脸新奇地东张西望来着

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 今后也要拜托你了♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
那就好。要是伤到像你
这么可爱的女孩子，那可不得了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 茉幌同学，该起床了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
如果不要点心，
那去车库来场即兴合奏怎么样？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 没有……又是不读不回

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: ……哎呀？这不是刚才的

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 那就更说明，萤同学你该唱了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 是呀，听得人心醉的歌声哦♡

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: ……这么一想，就让人兴奋得发抖呢♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
在昏暗狭小的空间里，
密密麻麻地挤满了一大群人

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 僵尸片♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: ……没问题哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 好了，快去吧♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 好，到此为止♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 刚刚才来的♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: ……难道说，这是你第一次来Live House？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
不过，这种心情我能体会。
毕竟Live House是个『特别』的地方呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
请尽情享受第一次看演出哦。
那么，失陪了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 今天的演出也非常精彩哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 做不到的事情就拜托能做到的人。服装也是如此
